description: Réseau beeMob - Transports en commun de l'Agglomération Béziers Méditerranée is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. Positioning of bus stops and bus lines in Shape format. Itineraries and times of transition to GTFS format. Coverage: Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. The portal shows the English title as "BeeMob network — Common transport of the Berziers Mediterranean Agglomeration" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. Its keywords include mobilite, bus, beemob, transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
